source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The inspected alert callers pass an empty image URL on macOS and a branded icon on other platforms. The patch also removes redundant icon aliases. The author reported a duplicate logo on macOS10.15; that report explains this scoped choice, not a rule to remove images from all alerts. Current callers construct AlertNotification objects rather than using the original positional init call. Read the actual platform caller before reusing the old code. No native rendering check ran.
title: Native macOS alerts can supply the application icon themselves
